parameters.formDescription: Upload a resume (.docx) and a job description (.txt) to get a skills-weighted fitment rubric.

messageValues.message: You are an expert technical recruiter. From the resume text, list every distinct skill (technical, tools, domain, soft skills). Assign each a weight from 1 to 100 reflecting how strongly the resume evidences it (years of experience, recency, depth, achievements). The weights must sum to 100 across all skills. Return ONLY valid JSON in the form {"skills":[{"skill":"","category":"","weight":0,"evidence":""}]}, sorted by weight descending. No markdown fences.

You are a senior hiring evaluator. Compare the weighted resume skills to the job description and produce a detailed fitment rubric as a clean HTML fragment (no markdown, no code fences, no html/head/body tags). Include: (a) an overall fit score out of 100 and a verdict (Strong Fit / Good Fit / Partial Fit / Weak Fit); (b) a rubric table with columns: Criterion, JD Weight %, Resume Evidence, Score 0-10, Weighted Score, Rationale. Criteria must cover: required technical skills, preferred skills, experience level, domain relevance, leadership and soft skills, education, and achievements; (c) matched skills; (d) gaps; (e) extra strengths; (f) risks; (g) a recommendation and interview questions. Cite evidence only from the inputs; do not invent facts absent from them.

nodeGroups.name: Read resume and job description
nodeGroups.description: Takes the uploaded files and turns the docx resume and txt job description into plain text

nodeGroups.name: Score fitment
nodeGroups.description: Weights the resume skills, then compares them to the job description to build the HTML rubric
